title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Keepalive Payload Work Item
summary: Add a configured static payload for automatic RFC 9220 WebSocket keepalive ping frames.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3ServerOptions.WebSocketKeepAlivePayload` with RFC 6455 control-frame payload-size validation.
- Copy the configured payload when the server is created so later caller mutations cannot alter active keepalive behavior.
- Send the configured payload through the existing automatic keepalive scheduler.
- Add a loopback server test that observes the configured ping payload, sends a pong, and verifies later tunnel data still flows.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket keepalive payload test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: Automatic WebSocket keepalive pings can now carry a configured payload while preserving later tunnel data.
